item.coloph: 'di ni dpal ldan zhi ba lhas gsungs pa'i mo rdzogs so/ /rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paN+Di ta gau ta ma shrI dang / bal po paN+Di ta ram dang / bal po rdzong gi rgyal po bla ma paN+Di ta bud+d+ha/ shrI dz+nyA na'i zhal snga nas mnyan nas mang du thos pa'i lo tsA/ gnas grtan dpal nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o
